label: Windbreak village
note: Ranch village outpost: the Remnant's building in Windbreak village (content/core/locations/ranch_windbreak.json has the houses, stands and walls round it). Built like every other outpost (src/systems/world/remnant_outposts.gd) and one of Story.OUTPOSTS, so holding it counts toward driving the Remnant off. 'after_cruiser': its troopers answer to the cruiser, so killing them all does nothing until the cruiser has fallen (Territory.locked): they come back like any outpost's. 'kind' village is its map pin. 'pad': false, the ranch's yard levels the ground instead. 'village': the ranch round it (its buildings are the nav's obstructions too).

zone.note: Issue #308: a ring of radius metres round the outpost is a checkpoint zone. Below the wave band the nearest trooper (a role below) who sees you walks up and the gate's card opens, on the gate's rules (content/core/soldiers/gate_guard.json checkpoint block; anything in this checkpoint block wins). Leave the ring and the card closes; cleared, the outpost leaves you alone for cleared_s.
